The '''Burning Moon Range''' was a group of seven active [[Volcano/Legends|volcanic]] [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kintan/Legends|Kintan]], and formed the western coastline of the [[Gluss'elta Sea]]. The seven volcanoes continually belched lava to the surface, where it flowed through the [[Canyon of Despair]] in what was known as the [[River of Fire|Fire River]].<ref name="Geonosis" />
